result.disposition: All twelve frozen attempts were rechecked against current exact-model pages or bounded saved sources. Conflicting weights, unclear revisions, fitted-only tire sizes, inaccessible listings, historical family-level evidence, and unmapped builds remain explicitly unresolved; no unsupported value was selected.

field_results.caveat: CycloPro lists 7.27 kg for a sold-out R9270/Dura-Ace 2025/R23 build and includes pedals, but gives no size or method. 99Spokes' saved 16.3 lb (~7.39 kg) record could not be reopened; generation and weighing basis are not shown to match.
The two manufacturer storefronts state 983±50 g and 953±50 g at 54 cm UD matte, respectively; neither establishes a shared weighing protocol.
Current T47 WheelTop pages list fitted Maxxis or Innova 700×40C tires but publish no maximum; fitted size is not a clearance specification.
The BXT-GRAVEL-135 page says 45C in its title/description and 47C in its table; a separate BXT-135 page states 47C. No revision bridge maps either frame page to the archived complete-bike card.
